title: ranunculus flammula var. ovalis
intro: Ranunculus flammula var. ovalis, commonly known as Lesser Spearwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing swelling, fighting off infections, and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Spearwort include its ability to inhibit the growth of microorganisms, reduce pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include alkaloids, saponins, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
